claims.statement: Idlirvirissong is an evil spirit in the religion of the Inuit of Baffin Island and Greenland.
claims.statement_id: Idlirvirissong adalah roh jahat dalam kepercayaan masyarakat Inuit di Pulau Baffin dan Greenland.
claims.quote: Idlirvirissong, or Irdlirvirisissong, is an evil spirit in the religion of the Inuit of Baffin Island and the Greenlandic Inuit.

claims.statement: Depicted as a clown with an upturned nose, she possesses numerous dogs.
claims.statement_id: Sosok ini digambarkan menyerupai badut dengan hidung melengkung ke atas dan memiliki banyak anjing.
claims.quote: Idlirvirissong is a demonic, evil spirit usually depicted as a clown, with a nose "turned up on the side." She owns many dogs

claims.statement: She is described as the cousin and adversary of the spirit of the Sun.
claims.statement_id: Ia disebut sebagai sepupu dan penentang dari roh Matahari.
claims.quote: Idlirvirissong is said to be the cousin of the spirit of the Sun, to whom she is opposed

claims.statement: In most descriptions Idlirvirissong is female, though some give the gender as male.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kebanyakan deskripsi Idlirvirissong perempuan, meskipun sebagian menyebutnya laki-laki.
claims.quote: In most descriptions, Idlirvirissong is a female, though some give Idlirvirissong's gender as a male.

claims.statement: Idlirvirissong lives in a house in the sky with her dogs, awaiting the newly deceased; when they arrive she dances, saying "Qimitiaka nexessaqtaqpaka" ("I am looking for food for my dogs").
claims.statement_id: Idlirvirissong tinggal di rumah di langit bersama anjing-anjingnya, menanti kedatangan orang yang baru meninggal; ketika mereka tiba ia menari sambil berkata "Qimitiaka nexessaqtaqpaka" ("Aku mencari makanan untuk anjing-anjingku").
claims.quote: Idlirvirissong lives in a house in the sky with her dogs, where she awaits the arrival of the newly deceased. When the deceased arrive, Idlirvirissong will dance while saying "Qimitiaka nexessaqtaqpaka" ("I am looking for food for my dogs").

claims.statement: Those who laugh at Idlirvirissong and her dance have their bodies cut open and their intestines placed on her plate called qengmerping and fed to the dogs; those who do not laugh are spared.
claims.statement_id: Mereka yang menertawakan Idlirvirissong dan tariannya akan dibelah tubuhnya, ususnya diletakkan di piring bernama qengmerping dan diberikan kepada anjing; yang tidak tertawa dibiarkan selamat.
claims.quote: Those who laugh at Idlirvirissong and her dance will have their bodies cut open, and their intestines placed on a Idlirvirissong's plate called qengmerping and be fed to the dogs. Those who do not laugh are spared.

claims.statement: In other parts of Greenland she is known as the Erdlaveersissok, the "entrail-seizer"; on Baffin Island a similar figure called Ululiernang or Ululiarnåq is present.
claims.statement_id: Di bagian lain Greenland ia dikenal sebagai Erdlaveersissok, "perebut isi perut"; di Pulau Baffin terdapat tokoh serupa bernama Ululiernang atau Ululiarnåq.
claims.quote: In other parts of Greenland, she is known as the Erdlaveersissok, the "entrail-seizer." In Baffin Island a similar figure known as Ululiernang or Ululiarnåq is present.

claims.statement: In some versions she is instead the cousin of the Moon spirit Aningan; in one version told by the Inuit of Smith Sound, Aningan warns people not to laugh around Idlirvirissong.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sebagian versi ia sepupu roh Bulan, Aningan; dalam satu versi yang dituturkan Inuit Smith Sound, Aningan memperingatkan orang agar tidak tertawa di dekat Idlirvirissong.
claims.quote: in some versions, she is the cousin of the Moon spirit Aningan instead. In one version recounted by the Inuit of Smith Sound, Aningan warns people not to laugh around Idlirvirissong.

claims.statement: Kroeber (1899) records that besides his wife and sister, Aningan has a female cousin, Irdlirvirisissong, who lives in the sky in a separate house, sometimes visits Aningan, and has her nose turned up on the sides.
claims.statement_id: Kroeber (1899) mencatat bahwa selain istri dan saudarinya, Aningan memiliki sepupu perempuan, Irdlirvirisissong, yang tinggal di langit di rumah terpisah, kadang mengunjungi Aningan, dan hidungnya terlipat ke atas di sisi-sisinya.
claims.quote: Irdlirvirisissong. She lives in the sky, but in a separate house, and sometimes visits Aningan. Her nose is turned up on the sides.

claims.statement: Kroeber's record says that those who laugh she cuts open and gives their entrails to the dogs, while others are spared.
claims.statement_id: Menurut catatan Kroeber, orang yang tertawa dibelahnya dan isi perutnya diberikan kepada anjing, sedangkan yang lain dibiarkan.
claims.quote: Those of the people that laugh, she cuts open, and gives their entrails to the dogs. Others are spared.

claims.statement: In Greenland she is called Erdlaveersissok ("the entrail-seizer"); residing on the way to the moon, she tempts people to laugh by her dancing and grimaces and, if successful, takes out their intestines.
claims.statement_id: Di Greenland ia disebut Erdlaveersissok ("perebut isi perut"); tinggal di jalan menuju bulan, ia menggoda orang tertawa dengan tarian dan seringai, dan bila berhasil mengeluarkan usus mereka.
claims.quote: In Greenland she is called' Erdlaveersissok' ('the entrail-seizer'). Residing on the way to the moon, she tempts people to laugh by her dancing and grimaces, and if successful takes out their intestines.

claims.statement: According to Kroeber, on Baffin Land the story is told as in Greenland, except that the woman, there the wife of the moon, is named Ululiernang.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Kroeber, di Pulau Baffin kisahnya sama seperti di Greenland, hanya saja perempuan itu, di sana istri bulan, bernama Ululiernang.
claims.quote: In Baffin Land the story is told as in Greenland, except that the woman, who is here the wife of the moon, is named Ululiernang.

claims.statement: Ululiernang has a hollow back and no entrails, and she offers the entrails she obtains to the moon's ermine.
claims.statement_id: Ululiernang berpunggung berongga dan tanpa isi perut, dan ia mempersembahkan isi perut yang diperolehnya kepada cerpelai milik bulan.
claims.quote: Ululiernang has a hollow back with her entrails missing, and she offers the entrails she acquired to the moon's ermine.

claims.statement: The Iemisch is a cryptid from Patagonia, specifically near the Lake Colhué region.
claims.statement_id: Iemisch adalah makhluk kriptid dari Patagonia, khususnya di pegunungan dekat kawasan Danau Colhué.
claims.quote: The Iemisch (a.k.a. Iemisch Listai) is a supposed cryptid from Patagonia, specifically in the mountains near the Lake Colhué region.

claims.statement: It is nocturnal and powerful enough to seize horses and drag them underwater.
claims.statement_id: Hewan nokturnal ini begitu kuat sehingga mampu mencengkeram kuda lalu menyeretnya ke dasar air.
claims.quote: The animal is of nocturnal habits, and it's said to be so strong that it can seize horses with its claws and drag them to the bottom of the water.

claims.statement: Lehmann-Nitsche writes that the word Jemisch, which according to Ameghino the Patagonian natives use for that Neomylodon, most probably means the otter (Lutra felina).
claims.statement_id: Lehmann-Nitsche menulis bahwa kata Jemisch, yang menurut Ameghino dipakai penduduk asli Patagonia untuk menyebut Neomylodon, kemungkinan besar berarti berang-berang (Lutra felina).
claims.quote: La palabra Jemisch (capítulo 11) con que según el señor Ameghino los indígenas de la Patagonia designan á aquel Neomylodon, significa muy probablemente la lutra (Lutra felina Mol.)

claims.statement: First attested by Florentino Ameghino in 1897; a full study appeared in the 1955 book On the Track of Unknown Animals.
claims.statement_id: Pertama dicatat oleh Florentino Ameghino pada 1897; kajian lengkapnya terbit dalam buku On the Track of Unknown Animals tahun 1955.
claims.quote: First attested to by Florentino Ameghino in 1897, a full study on the creature was published in the 1955 book On the Track of Unknown Animals.

claims.statement: According to the description in the original letter, it has a short head, big canines and no external ears, short plantigrade feet with three toes on the forefeet and four on the hind ones, webbed for swimming and armed with formidable claws, and a long, flat, prehensile tail.
claims.statement_id: Menurut deskripsi dalam surat asli, kepalanya pendek, bertaring besar, tanpa telinga luar, berkaki pendek plantigrad dengan tiga jari depan dan empat belakang berselaput renang dan bercakar kuat, berekor panjang, pipih, dan dapat menggenggam.
claims.quote: According to the description I have been given, it has a short head, big canine teeth, and no external ears: its feet are short and plantigrade, with three toes on the forefeet and four on the hind, three toaes are formed by a membrane for swimming, and are also armed with formidable claws. Its tail is long, flat and prehensile.

claims.statement: It reportedly could move as quickly on land as in water and was described as having a "soul-wrenching scream".
claims.statement_id: Konon ia bergerak secepat di darat seperti di air, dan digambarkan memiliki jeritan "soul-wrenching".
claims.quote: It reportedly could move as quickly on land as in the water, and was described as having a "soul-wrenching scream".

claims.statement: Robert Lehmann-Nitsche, a German anthropologist in Argentina, claimed to have a sample of iemisch skin from a local rancher, with small bone plates embedded in it that protected the creature from arrowheads.
claims.statement_id: Robert Lehmann-Nitsche, antropolog Jerman di Argentina, mengaku memiliki contoh kulit iemisch dari seorang peternak setempat, dengan keping tulang kecil tertanam di kulit yang melindunginya dari mata panah.
claims.quote: Robert Lehmann-Nitsche, a German anthropologist working in Argentina, claimed to have a sample of the iemisch's skin given to him by a local rancher. He stated that there were small bone plates embedded in its skin, which protected the creature from arrowheads.

claims.statement: Lehmann-Nitsche and Santiago Roth later published more iemisch tales, concluding it must be an unknown type of otter; paleontologist John Bell Hatcher noted that despite spending as much time with Patagonian natives he had never heard of such a creature.
claims.statement_id: Lehmann-Nitsche dan Santiago Roth kemudian menerbitkan lebih banyak kisah iemisch dan menyimpulkan bahwa iemisch tentulah sejenis berang-berang yang belum dikenal; paleontolog John Bell Hatcher mencatat bahwa walau lama bersama penduduk asli Patagonia ia tak pernah mendengar makhluk semacam itu.
claims.quote: Robert Lehmann-Nitsche and Santiago Roth would eventually publish more iemisch tales, concluding that the iemisch must be an unknown type of otter. Upon peer review, paleontologist John Bell Hatcher noted that though he had spent equal amounts of time with Patagonian natives, he had never heard of such a creature.

claims.statement: Later scholars also cast doubt on Heuvelmans's research, noting that the word 'Iemisch' is not associated with any language spoken in Patagonia.
claims.statement_id: Para sarjana kemudian meragukan penelitian Heuvelmans, mencatat bahwa kata 'Iemisch' tidak dikaitkan dengan bahasa mana pun yang dituturkan di Patagonia.
claims.quote: Later scholars also cast doubt on research by Heuvelmans, noting that the word 'Iemisch' isn't associated with any language spoken in Patagonia.

claims.statement: Lehmann-Nitsche argues that the Indians' myths, legends and tales of a fierce animal mostly may refer to the jaguar (tigre).
claims.statement_id: Lehmann-Nitsche berpendapat bahwa mitos, legenda, dan cerita orang Indian tentang hewan buas sebagian besar dapat merujuk pada macan (tigre).
claims.quote: Los mitos (capítulo III), leyendas y cuentos de los indios en que se habla de un animal feroz, pueden referirse en su mayoría al tigre

claims.statement: Lehmann-Nitsche lists other spellings of the name from earlier recorders: Chimchimen (de la Cruz and Gay), Jémechim (Lista), Yem'chen (Moreno), Jemisch (Carlos Ameghino) and Hymché (Tournouer).
claims.statement_id: Lehmann-Nitsche mendaftar ejaan lain nama ini dari para pencatat sebelumnya: Chimchimen (Febres, de la Cruz dan Gay), Jémechim (Lista), Yem'chen (Moreno), Jemisch (Carlos Ameghino), dan Hymché (Tournouer).
claims.quote: « Chimchimen », de la Cruz y Gay. «Jémechim», Lista. « Yem'chen», Moreno. «Jemisch», Carlos Ameghino. « Hymché », Tournouer.

claims.statement: Lehmann-Nitsche records that Tournouer claimed to have seen the enigmatic neomylodon living in the water in Patagonia, and his guide called it Hymché.
claims.statement_id: Lehmann-Nitsche mencatat bahwa Tournouer mengaku melihat neomylodon yang misterius hidup di air di Patagonia, dan pemandunya menyebutnya Hymché.
claims.quote: haber visto en la Patagonia al neomylodon enigmático, vivo en el agua. El guía lo llamó Hymché.

claims.statement: The Igopogo is a legendary creature in Canadian folklore dwelling in Lake Simcoe, Ontario.
claims.statement_id: Igopogo adalah makhluk legendaris dalam cerita rakyat Kanada yang menghuni Danau Simcoe, Ontario.
claims.quote: In Canadian folklore, the Igopogo is a legendary creature said to dwell in Lake Simcoe, Ontario.

claims.statement: The name is ostensibly based on the Ogopogo of Lake Okanagan, British Columbia.
claims.statement_id: Nama makhluk ini tampaknya didasarkan pada Ogopogo dari Danau Okanagan, British Columbia.
claims.quote: The creature's name is ostensibly based on the Ogopogo of Lake Okanagan, British Columbia

claims.statement: David Soules is credited with the first reported Igopogo sighting in 1823.
claims.statement_id: David Soules diyakini sebagai orang pertama yang melaporkan penampakan Igopogo pada tahun 1823.
claims.quote: David Soules, an early settler, is credited with the first alleged Igopogo sighting in 1823.

claims.statement: Other nicknames for the Igopogo are Beaverton Bessie, after Beaverton, Ontario, and "Kempenfelt Kelly", after the bay that extends from the lake into the city of Barrie, Ontario.
claims.statement_id: Nama lain Igopogo adalah Beaverton Bessie, dari Beaverton, Ontario, dan "Kempenfelt Kelly", dari teluk yang menjorok dari danau ke kota Barrie, Ontario.
claims.quote: Other nicknames for the Igopogo include Beaverton Bessie, after Beaverton, Ontario, and "Kempenfelt Kelly", after the bay that extends from the lake into the city of Barrie, Ontario.

claims.statement: While tending sheep, Soules reportedly saw a long creature leaving a wake in the water and a trail in the mud.
claims.statement_id: Saat menggembala domba, Soules dilaporkan melihat makhluk panjang yang meninggalkan riak di air dan jejak di lumpur.
claims.quote: While tending sheep, Soules reportedly saw a long creature leaving a wake in the water and a trail in the mud.

claims.statement: Descriptions of the Igopogo vary. George M. Eberhart describes it as a gray, seal-like animal 12–70 feet (3.7–21.3 m) long with a dog- or horse-like face, prominent eyes, a gaping mouth, dorsal fins, and a fishlike tail.
claims.statement_id: Gambaran Igopogo beragam. George M. Eberhart menggambarkannya sebagai hewan abu-abu mirip anjing laut sepanjang 12–70 kaki (3,7–21,3 m) dengan wajah seperti anjing atau kuda, mata menonjol, mulut menganga, sirip punggung, dan ekor seperti ikan.
claims.quote: Descriptions of the Igopogo vary. Writer George M. Eberhart describes the Igopogo as a gray, seal-like animal stretching 12–70 feet (3.7–21.3 m) in length with a dog- or horse-like face, prominent eyes, a gaping mouth, dorsal fins, and a fishlike tail

claims.statement: Some writers have speculated, based on this appearance, that the sightings were actually of pinnipeds such as seals or mustelids such as otters.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian penulis menduga, berdasarkan penampilan itu, bahwa penampakan tersebut sebenarnya hewan pinniped seperti anjing laut atau mustelid seperti berang-berang.
claims.quote: Some writers have speculated based on this appearance that the sightings were actually of pinnipeds, such as seals, or mustelids, such as otters.

claims.statement: Residents of Beaverton on the eastern shore call it Beaverton Bessie, while others call it Kempenfelt Kelly, after Kempenfelt Bay, which has the lake's deepest water and the most sightings.
claims.statement_id: Warga Beaverton di tepi timur menyebutnya Beaverton Bessie, sedangkan yang lain menyebutnya Kempenfelt Kelly, dari Kempenfelt Bay, bagian danau yang paling dalam dan paling banyak dilaporkan penampakannya.
claims.quote: Residents of Beaverton, on the eastern shore, call it Beaverton Bessie, while others refer to it as Kempenfelt Kelly, after Kempenfelt Bay, which has the lake's deepest water and claims the most sightings.

claims.statement: According to John Robert Colombo in his book "Mysterious Canada," no two descriptions of Kempenfelt Kelly coincide.
claims.statement_id: Menurut John Robert Colombo dalam bukunya "Mysterious Canada", tidak ada dua deskripsi Kempenfelt Kelly yang sama.
claims.quote: Significantly, according to John Robert Colombo in his book "Mysterious Canada," "No two descriptions of Kempenfelt Kelly coincide."

claims.statement: The article's author says that many sightings, including one he heard directly from a witness, could reasonably be explained as otters swimming in a line, diving and resurfacing.
claims.statement_id: Penulis artikel menyatakan bahwa banyak laporan penampakan, termasuk salah satu yang ia dengar langsung dari seorang saksi, dapat dijelaskan secara wajar sebagai berang-berang yang berenang berjajar, menyelam, dan muncul kembali.
claims.quote: Like many of the other sightings, his could be reasonably explained as otters swimming in a line, diving and resurfacing.

claims.statement: The article's author reports that their search for Igopogo ended without good evidence for the monster, and that sightings will surely continue as long as people believe it exists in the cold waters of Lake Simcoe.
claims.statement_id: Penulis artikel melaporkan bahwa pencarian mereka atas Igopogo berakhir tanpa bukti yang baik, tetapi penampakan akan terus dilaporkan selama orang percaya makhluk itu ada di perairan dingin Lake Simcoe.
claims.quote: Our search for Igopogo ended without finding good evidence for the monster, but the sightings will surely continue as long as people believe it exists in the cold waters of Lake Simcoe.

claims.statement: The creature's name is ostensibly based on the Ogopogo of Lake Okanagan, British Columbia, and also on the title of the 1952 book I Go Pogo, a slogan often mentioned in the comic.
claims.statement_id: Nama makhluk ini tampaknya didasarkan pada Ogopogo dari Lake Okanagan, British Columbia, dan juga pada judul buku I Go Pogo tahun 1952, semboyan yang sering disebut dalam komik itu.
claims.quote: The creature's name is ostensibly based on the Ogopogo of Lake Okanagan, British Columbia, and also the title of the 1952 book I Go Pogo, a slogan often mentioned in the comic.

claims.statement: Important sightings occurred in 1952 and 1963; a "sonar sounding of a large animal" in 1983 was followed by a videotape in 1991 of "a large, seal-like animal."
claims.statement_id: Penampakan penting terjadi pada 1952 dan 1963; "sonar sounding of a large animal" pada 1983 disusul rekaman video tahun 1991 tentang "a large, seal-like animal".
claims.quote: Important sightings occurred in 1952 and 1963, and a "sonar sounding of a large animal" in 1983 was followed by a videotape in 1991 of "a large, seal-like animal."

claims.statement: The city of Barrie erected The Sea Serpent sculpture, representing the legendary Igopogo, at the waterfront.
claims.statement_id: Kota Barrie mendirikan patung The Sea Serpent di tepi air yang menggambarkan Igopogo yang legendaris.
claims.quote: The city of Barrie erected The Sea Serpent sculpture, representing the legendary Igopogo, at the waterfront.

claims.statement: In 1983, sonar operator William W. Skrypetz reported spotting a large animal with a long neck, although some have disputed this, saying the reading could instead have been a school of fish.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1983, operator sonar William W. Skrypetz melaporkan melihat hewan besar berleher panjang, meski sebagian orang membantahnya dan menyebut pembacaan itu bisa jadi gerombolan ikan.
claims.quote: In 1983, sonar operator William W. Skrypetz reported spotting a large animal with a long neck, although some have disputed this account, claiming the reading could have instead been a school of fish.

claims.statement: In the Chilote folklore and mythology of Chiloé Island in southern Chile, the imbunche (Mapudungun: ifünche, "short person") is a legendary monster that protects the entrance to a warlock's cave.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Chilote dari Pulau Chiloé di Chili selatan, imbunche (Mapudungun: ifünche, "orang pendek") adalah monster legendaris yang melindungi pintu masuk gua seorang penyihir.
claims.quote: In the Chilote folklore and Chilote mythology of Chiloé Island in southern Chile, the imbunche (Mapudungun: ifünche, lit. "short person") is a legendary monster that protects the entrance to a warlock's cave.

claims.statement: The imbunche is a deformed human with head twisted backwards and twisted limbs.
claims.statement_id: Imbunche adalah manusia cacat dengan kepala terpelintir ke belakang serta anggota tubuh yang bengkok.
claims.quote: The imbunche is a deformed human with its head twisted backwards, along with having twisted arms, fingers, nose, mouth and ears.

claims.statement: According to lore, it is a newborn child kidnapped by or sold to a Brujo Chilote warlock.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, imbunche adalah bayi sulung yang diculik atau dijual kepada penyihir Brujo Chilote.
claims.quote: According to legend, the imbunche is a first-born child less than nine days old that was kidnapped by, or sold by their parents to, a Brujo Chilote

claims.statement: The creature walks on one foot or three feet (actually one leg and two hands) because one of its legs is attached to the back of its neck. It has blue skin and sharp teeth.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini berjalan dengan satu kaki atau tiga kaki (sebenarnya satu kaki dan dua tangan) karena salah satu kakinya melekat di belakang lehernya. Kulitnya biru dan giginya tajam.
claims.quote: The creature walks on one foot or on three feet (actually one leg and two hands) because one of its legs is attached to the back of its neck. It has blue skin and sharp teeth.

claims.statement: The imbunche cannot talk and communicates only through guttural, rough and unpleasant sounds.
claims.statement_id: Imbunche tidak dapat berbicara dan hanya berkomunikasi dengan bunyi parau, kasar, dan tidak enak didengar.
claims.quote: The imbunche cannot talk, and communicates only by guttural, rough and unpleasant sounds.

claims.statement: The Brujo chilote turns the child into a deformed hairy monster by breaking its right leg and twisting it over its back. At three months its tongue is forked, its teeth become sharp, its skin turns blue, and the warlock applies a magic cream to its back to make thick hair grow.
claims.statement_id: Brujo chilote mengubah anak itu menjadi monster cacat berbulu dengan mematahkan kaki kanannya dan memelintirnya ke punggung. Pada usia tiga bulan lidahnya dibelah, giginya meruncing, kulitnya membiru, dan sang penyihir mengoleskan krim ajaib di punggungnya agar tumbuh bulu tebal.
claims.quote: The Brujo chilote transforms the child into a deformed hairy monster by breaking their right leg and twisting it over their back. When the child is three months old their tongue is forked, their teeth turn sharp, their skin turns blue, and the warlock applies a magic cream over the child's back to cause thick hairs.

claims.statement: Besides guarding the entrance to the warlock's cave, the imbunche is used by warlocks as an instrument of revenge or curses. Because it gains magical knowledge while guarding the cave, it sometimes acts as the warlock's advisor even though it is not initiated into wizardry.
claims.statement_id: Selain menjaga pintu masuk gua penyihir, imbunche dipakai para penyihir sebagai alat balas dendam atau kutukan. Karena memperoleh pengetahuan gaib selama menjaga gua, ia kadang menjadi penasihat sang penyihir meski tidak diinisiasi dalam ilmu sihir.
claims.quote: Besides guarding the entrance to the warlock's cave, the imbunche is used by warlocks as an instrument for revenge or curses. And, because it has acquired magical knowledge over its lifetime spent guarding the cave, even if the imbunche is not initiated into wizardry, it sometimes acts as the warlock's advisor.

claims.statement: The imbunche leaves the cave only in certain circumstances, such as when the cave is destroyed or discovered and the warlock moves to another cave, or when the warlocks need it and carry it out thrashing and yelling, frightening the townspeople and announcing misfortune to come.
claims.statement_id: Imbunche meninggalkan gua hanya dalam keadaan tertentu, misalnya saat gua dihancurkan atau ditemukan dan sang penyihir pindah ke gua lain, atau saat para penyihir membutuhkannya dan membawanya keluar sambil meronta dan berteriak, menakuti warga dan menandakan nasib buruk yang akan datang.
claims.quote: The imbunche leaves the cave only in certain circumstances, such as when the cave is destroyed or discovered and the warlock moves to another cave, or when the warlocks have need of it and carry it thrashing and yelling, scaring the townspeople and announcing misfortune to come.

claims.statement: During its first months the imbunche is fed black cat's milk and goat flesh and, when old enough, human corpses from cemeteries.
claims.statement_id: Pada bulan-bulan pertama imbunche diberi susu kucing hitam dan daging kambing, dan setelah cukup besar diberi mayat manusia dari pemakaman.
claims.quote: During its first months the imbunche is fed on black cat's milk and goat flesh, and when old enough, with human corpses from cemeteries.

claims.statement: José Donoso's magical realist novel The Obscene Bird of Night reinterprets imbunche folklore as a way of binding a male child in a sack to prevent escape and bodily growth.
claims.statement_id: Novel realisme magis José Donoso, The Obscene Bird of Night, menafsir ulang cerita rakyat imbunche sebagai cara mengikat anak laki-laki dalam karung untuk mencegah pelarian dan pertumbuhan tubuh.
claims.quote: José Donoso's magical realist novel The Obscene Bird of Night reinterprets imbunche folklore as a way to bind a male child in a sack to prevent escape and bodily growth.

claims.statement: The invunche or imbunche (from Mapudungun ifünche, "persona deforme", a deformed person) is a being of Mapuche and Chilote mythology. In Chiloé it is also called Machucho, Butamacho or Chivato.
claims.statement_id: Invunche atau imbunche (dari kata Mapudungun ifünche, "persona deforme" atau orang cacat bentuk) adalah makhluk dari mitologi Mapuche dan mitologi Chilote. Di Chiloé ia juga disebut Machucho, Butamacho, atau Chivato.
claims.quote: El invunche o imbunche (del mapudungun ifünche: "persona deforme") es un ser de la mitología mapuche y de la mitología chilota. En Chiloé también recibe el nombre de Machucho, Butamacho o Chivato.

claims.statement: Its head would be flattened with a pair of boards and twisted in the process to give it an elongated shape; finally its tongue would be split in two to imitate the tongue of snakes.
claims.statement_id: Kepalanya dipipihkan dengan dua papan dan dipelintir sehingga berbentuk memanjang; terakhir lidahnya dibelah dua untuk meniru lidah ular.
claims.quote: se aplastaría su cabeza con un par de tablas y torcerían su cabeza en el proceso para darle una forma alargada. Por último le partirían la lengua en dos, para imitar la lengua de las serpientes.

claims.statement: After this ritual the new Invunche must be fed in a special way: first black cat's milk or the milk of an indigenous wet nurse, then, once it has teeth, "cabrito" meat (meaning the flesh of a newborn child), and when it is older "chivo" meat (meaning the flesh of an adult person).
claims.statement_id: Setelah ritual itu, imbunche baru diberi makan secara khusus: pertama susu kucing hitam atau susu inang Pribumi, lalu setelah bergigi daging "cabrito" (maksudnya daging bayi baru lahir), dan setelah lebih dewasa daging "chivo" (maksudnya daging orang dewasa).
claims.quote: Después de este ritual, deben alimentar al nuevo Invunche de una manera especial; primeramente le darían leche de gata negra o leche de una nodriza indígena, luego cuando tiene dientes, le darían carne de "cabrito" (refiriéndose a carne de niño recién nacido), y cuando es más adulto le darían carne de "chivo" (refiriéndose a carne de persona adulta).

claims.statement: The Imbunche is a human being who stands on one foot while the other is stuck to the back, so it moves in little hops. Its arms are twisted and its face is turned backward.
claims.statement_id: Imbunche adalah manusia yang bertumpu pada satu kaki sementara kaki lainnya melekat di punggung, sehingga ia berjalan melompat-lompat kecil. Lengannya terpelintir dan wajahnya menghadap ke belakang.
claims.quote: ser humano que se sostiene en un pie y el otro lo lleva pegado a la espalda; por esta causa, anda a saltitos. Tiene los brazos torcidos y la cara vuelta hacia

claims.statement: It does not speak; it bleats like a young goat in an extraordinary way. It is also called Chivato de la cueva.
claims.statement_id: Imbunche tidak berbicara; ia mengembik seperti anak kambing dengan cara yang luar biasa. Ia juga dinamai Chivato de la cueva.
claims.quote: No habla, bala como un chivato, pero en una forma extraordinaria. ... el nombre de Chivato de la cueva.

claims.statement: To obtain this human figure the warlocks use a young child, and as it grows its organs are arranged until they suit its purpose. It is fed with the flesh and blood of a newborn child.
claims.statement_id: Untuk memperoleh sosok manusia ini, para penyihir memakai seorang anak kecil; seiring ia tumbuh, organ-organnya ditata hingga sesuai tujuannya. Ia diberi makan daging dan darah bayi yang baru lahir.
claims.quote: Para lograr esta figura humana, los brujos emplean un ... de corta edad, y a medida que va creciendo se le acomodan los ... hasta que quedan dispuestos para su finalidad. Lo alimentan con carne y sangre de

claims.statement: It leaves only when the cave is changed or has been destroyed; it is generally carried on shoulders when there is a move.
claims.statement_id: Imbunche hanya keluar ketika gua dipindahkan atau telah dihancurkan; umumnya ia dipanggul di bahu ketika terjadi pemindahan.
claims.quote: Unicamente sale cuando ... se cambia o ha sido destruida. Generalmente, es llevado en hombros, cuando hay traslado.

claims.statement: The Imbunche, or Invunche, is also Vuta or Vutamacho, and some call it Machucho, but describe it as an animal that bleats like a goat and walks on two hands and one foot, only at night.
claims.statement_id: Imbunche atau Invunche juga disebut Vuta atau Vutamacho, dan sebagian menyebutnya Machucho, tetapi mereka menggambarkannya sebagai hewan yang mengembik seperti kambing dan berjalan dengan dua tangan dan satu kaki, hanya pada malam hari.
claims.quote: El Imbunche, o Invunche, es, ... Vuta o Vutamacho y algunos lo llaman Machucho, pero lo describen como un animal que bala como cabro y que anda con las dos manos y un pie, ... por la noche.

claims.statement: According to legend, the warlocks' society worked out of a cave, the Cueva de Quicaví or Casa Grande, which was guarded by a deformed being, the Imbunche.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, perkumpulan para penyihir bekerja dari sebuah gua, Cueva de Quicaví atau Casa Grande, yang dijaga oleh makhluk cacat bernama Imbunche.
claims.quote: The seat of the King was in the Cueva de Quicaví or Casa Grande, in the surroundings of Quicaví, in the commune of Quemchi. According to legend, the society worked out of a cave that was guarded by a deformed being, the Imbunche.

claims.statement: A joint snake is a legendary creature of the Southern United States.
claims.statement_id: Ular sambung adalah makhluk legendaris dari wilayah Amerika Serikat bagian selatan.
claims.quote: A joint snake is a legendary creature of the Southern United States, the myth likely having spread elsewhere.

claims.statement: The snake can supposedly break itself into pieces and reassemble itself.
claims.statement_id: Konon ular sambung dapat memutuskan tubuhnya menjadi beberapa bagian lalu menyambungkannya kembali.
claims.quote: Supposedly, the joint snake can break itself (or be cut) into pieces and will reassemble itself.

claims.statement: Mistaken identity is probably responsible for the myth of snakes breaking apart and reconnecting.
claims.statement_id: Kekeliruan identifikasi kemungkinan besar menjadi pemicu lahirnya mitos ular yang menyambung ini.
claims.quote: Mistaken identity is probably responsible for the myth that some snakes can magically break apart and reconnect the pieces

claims.statement: It is said that if a piece of the snake is taken and the pocket knife used to cut it is set down in place of that piece, the knife will join up with the rest of the snake.
claims.statement_id: Dikatakan bahwa jika sepotong ular itu diambil dan pisau lipat yang dipakai memotongnya diletakkan di tempat potongan tersebut, pisau itu akan menyatu dengan seluruh tubuh ular.
claims.quote: It is said that if a piece of the snake is taken and the pocket knife used to cut the snake is set down in the place of the snake's piece, the knife will join up with the whole of the snake.

claims.statement: According to travelers' accounts, its skin is as hard as parchment and as smooth as glass, and so stiff that it can hardly bend. When struck it breaks; with a whip it can be broken from tail to bowels into pieces less than an inch long, without the least trace of blood.
claims.statement_id: Menurut catatan para pelancong, kulitnya sekeras perkamen dan selicin kaca, dan begitu kaku sehingga hampir tak dapat menekuk. Jika dipukul ia pecah; dengan cambuk orang dapat memecahnya dari ekor sampai usus menjadi potongan yang panjangnya kurang dari satu inci, tanpa setetes darah pun.
claims.quote: According to travelers' accounts, their skin is as hard as parchment and as smooth as glass. It is so stiff that it can hardly bend itself. When it is struck it breaks, and you may, with a whip, break it from the tail to the bowels into pieces not an inch long, and not produce the least tincture of blood.

claims.statement: One species of lizard has a long, snakelike body and no legs. These legless lizards are commonly called "glass snakes" or "joint snakes," even though they are not snakes at all.
claims.statement_id: Satu spesies kadal bertubuh panjang seperti ular dan tak berkaki. Kadal tak berkaki ini lazim disebut "glass snakes" atau "joint snakes", padahal bukan ular sama sekali.
claims.quote: One species of lizard has a long, snakelike body and no legs. These legless lizards are commonly called "glass snakes" or "joint snakes," even though they are not snakes at all.

claims.statement: It is physically impossible for any snake to do this and live, but another type of reptile comes close: lizards can cast off body parts when attacked and then regrow them.
claims.statement_id: Secara fisik mustahil bagi ular mana pun melakukannya dan tetap hidup, tetapi jenis reptil lain mendekatinya: kadal dapat melepas bagian tubuh saat diserang lalu menumbuhkannya kembali.
claims.quote: It's physically impossible for any snake to do so and live, but another type of reptile comes close. Lizards are able to cast off body parts when under attack, then regrow them.

claims.statement: Messrs. O. R. Glover and Charles H. Lawrence of Chicago supplied a living specimen of a "joint- or glass-snake" that had been captured on their farm in Starke County, Indiana.
claims.statement_id: Messrs. O. R. Glover dan Charles H. Lawrence dari Chicago menyerahkan spesimen hidup "joint- or glass-snake" yang ditangkap di pertanian milik mereka di Starke County, Indiana.
claims.quote: Messrs. O. R. Glover and Charles H. Lawrence, of Chicago, favored us with a living specimen of joint- or glass-snake, which had been captured on a farm owned by them in Starke County, Indiana.

claims.statement: The creature was sent for examination to Dr. W. A. Conklin, Director of the Central Park Menagerie, New York, who kindly furnished the following report.
claims.statement_id: Hewan itu dikirim untuk diperiksa kepada Dr. W. A. Conklin, Direktur Central Park Menagerie, New York, yang berbaik hati menyusun laporan berikut.
claims.quote: the creature was sent for examination to Dr. W. A. Conklin, Director of the Central Park Menagerie, New York, who has kindly furnished the following report.

claims.statement: A letter in the magazine says the theory that a full-fledged vertebrate animal such as this could unjoint and rejoint itself seems hardly worthy of discussion.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah surat dalam majalah itu menyatakan bahwa teori bahwa hewan bertulang belakang yang utuh seperti ini dapat melepas dan menyambung sendiri sambungan tubuhnya tampaknya hampir tak layak dibahas.
claims.quote: The theory that a full-fledged vertebrate animal such as this should possess power of unjointing and rejointing itself seems hardly worthy of discussion.

claims.statement: The dissection report quoted in the letter states that it is no more possible for the animal to unjoint than for a person to unjoint his head from his trunk.
claims.statement_id: Laporan pembedahan dalam surat itu menyatakan bahwa hewan itu tidak mungkin melepas sambungan tubuhnya, sama seperti seseorang tak mungkin melepas kepalanya dari batang tubuhnya.
claims.quote: There is no more possibility for it to unjoint than for a person to unjoint his head from his trunk.

claims.statement: A common myth about legless lizards (genus Ophisaurus, also called "jointed lizards" and "glass lizards") is that when disturbed they break into segments that later rejoin.
claims.statement_id: Mitos umum tentang kadal tak berkaki (genus Ophisaurus, yang juga disebut "jointed lizards" dan "glass lizards") adalah bahwa saat terganggu mereka pecah menjadi segmen-segmen yang kemudian menyambung kembali.
claims.quote: A common myth concerning legless lizards (genus Ophisaurus; which are also called "jointed lizards" and "glass lizards") is that when they are disturbed they will break up into segments and that these segments rejoin at a later time.

claims.statement: Legless lizards, like other lizards, can break off part of their tail to escape danger, but once a lizard loses a portion of its body it can never reattach it.
claims.statement_id: Kadal tak berkaki, seperti kadal lain, dapat melepas bagian ekornya untuk lolos dari bahaya, tetapi setelah kehilangan sebagian tubuhnya kadal tidak pernah dapat menyambungkannya kembali.
claims.quote: Legless lizards are similar to other lizards in that they have the ability to break off portions of their tail in order to escape danger. However, once a lizard loses a portion of its body it is never able to reattach that portion.

claims.statement: A joint snake symbolizes the American colonies in Benjamin Franklin's 1754 political cartoon, Join, or Die.
claims.statement_id: Seekor joint snake melambangkan koloni-koloni Amerika dalam kartun politik Benjamin Franklin tahun 1754, Join, or Die.
claims.quote: A joint snake symbolizes the American colonies in Benjamin Franklin's 1754 political cartoon, Join, or Die.

claims.statement: A jumbee or jumbie is a type of spirit or demon in folklore across Caribbean nations, Colombia, and Venezuela.
claims.statement_id: Jumbee atau jumbie adalah jenis roh atau iblis dalam cerita rakyat Karibia, Kolombia, dan Venezuela.
claims.quote: A jumbee or jumbie, also known as mendo or chongo in Colombia and Venezuela, is a type of mythological spirit or demon in the folklore of some Caribbean countries.

claims.statement: Jumbee can serve as a generic designation for all malevolent entities.
claims.statement_id: Nama jumbee dapat digunakan sebagai sebutan umum bagi semua entitas jahat.
claims.quote: "Jumbee" can be a generic name given to all malevolent entities.

claims.statement: There are numerous kinds of jumbees reflecting the region's complex history and ethnic makeup.
claims.statement_id: Ada banyak jenis jumbee yang mencerminkan kerumitan sejarah dan komposisi etnis Karibia.
claims.quote: There are numerous kinds of jumbees, reflecting the Caribbean's complex history and ethnic makeup

claims.statement: Different cultures have different concepts of jumbees, but the general idea is that people who have been evil are destined to become instruments of evil (jumbees) in death. Unlike ghost folklore's wispy, fog-like entity, the jumbee is cast as a dark, shadowy figure.
claims.statement_id: Tiap budaya punya konsep jumbee sendiri, tetapi gagasan umumnya adalah bahwa orang yang pernah berbuat jahat ditakdirkan menjadi alat kejahatan (jumbee) setelah mati. Berbeda dari cerita hantu yang berupa sosok tipis seperti kabut, jumbee digambarkan sebagai sosok gelap dan berbayang.
claims.quote: Different cultures have different concepts of jumbees, but the general idea is that people who have been evil are destined to become instruments of evil (jumbees) in death. Unlike the ghost folklore which represents a wispy fog-like entity, the jumbee is cast as a dark, shadowy figure.

claims.statement: In the folk religion of Montserrat, a jumbie is a ghost, or spirit of the dead. Jumbies are said to possess people during ceremonies called jumbie dances, accompanied by jumbie drums.
claims.statement_id: Dalam agama rakyat Montserrat, jumbie adalah hantu atau roh orang mati. Jumbie dikatakan merasuki orang dalam upacara yang disebut jumbie dance, diiringi genderang jumbie.
claims.quote: In the folk religion of Montserrat, a jumbie is a ghost, or spirit of the dead. Jumbies are said to possess people during ceremonies called jumbie dances, which are accompanied by jumbie drums.

claims.statement: It is believed that the spirit separates from the body three days after death, at which point the havoc begins. Jumbies are believed able to shape-shift, usually into a dog, a pig or, more likely, a cat.
claims.statement_id: Diyakini roh terpisah dari tubuh tiga hari setelah kematian, dan saat itulah kekacauan dimulai. Jumbie dipercaya dapat berubah wujud, biasanya menjadi anjing, babi, atau lebih mungkin kucing.
claims.quote: It is believed that the spirit separates from the body three days after death, at which point the havoc begins. Jumbies are believed to have the ability to shape-shift, usually taking the form of a dog, pig, or more likely, a cat.

claims.statement: Jumbies receive numerous small offerings from Montserratians, such as a few drops of rum or food.
claims.statement_id: Jumbie menerima banyak persembahan kecil dari warga Montserrat, seperti beberapa tetes rum atau makanan.
claims.quote: Jumbies receive numerous small offerings from Montserratians, such as a few drops of rum or food.

claims.statement: In the French islands of Guadeloupe and Martinique, people say "zombi" rather than "jumbie" for ghosts, revenants and other supernatural creatures.
claims.statement_id: Di pulau-pulau Prancis, Guadeloupe dan Martinique, orang menyebut "zombi" dan bukan "jumbie" untuk menggambarkan hantu, arwah yang kembali, dan makhluk gaib lainnya.
claims.quote: In the French islands Guadeloupe and Martinique, people speak of "zombi" rather than "jumbie" to describe ghosts, revenants, and other supernatural creatures.

claims.statement: In Jamaica and Barbados the old Akan word "duppy" is used rather than the Kikongo-rooted word "jumbee."
claims.statement_id: Di Jamaika dan Barbados dipakai kata Akan lama "duppy", bukan kata "jumbee" yang berakar Kikongo.
claims.quote: In Jamaica and Barbados, the old Akan word "duppy" is used rather than the Kikongo-rooted word "jumbee."

claims.statement: People in English-speaking Caribbean states colonized by the British commonly believe in this creature. The belief is also held by practitioners of Obeah, a form of mystical wizardry combining traditional African beliefs with Western European, primarily Anglican, images and beliefs about the dead.
claims.statement_id: Orang di negara-negara Karibia berbahasa Inggris bekas jajahan Inggris umumnya mempercayai makhluk ini. Kepercayaan itu juga dianut para praktisi Obeah, bentuk ilmu gaib yang memuat kepercayaan tradisional Afrika serta gambaran dan kepercayaan Eropa Barat, terutama Anglikan, tentang orang mati.
claims.quote: People in English-speaking Caribbean states that were colonized by the British commonly believe in this creature. The belief is also held by practitioners of Obeah, a form of mystical wizardry that encompasses traditional African beliefs and Western European, primarily Anglican, images and beliefs concerning the dead.

claims.statement: Guyana and various islands, including Antigua and Barbuda in the east, The Bahamas in the north and as far south as Trinidad, have long held a folklore tradition that includes the jumbee.
claims.statement_id: Guyana dan berbagai pulau, termasuk Antigua dan Barbuda di timur, Bahama di utara, dan sejauh Trinidad di selatan, telah lama memiliki tradisi cerita rakyat yang memuat jumbee.
claims.quote: Guyana, and various islands—including Antigua and Barbuda in the east, The Bahamas in the north and as far south as Trinidad—have long held a tradition of folklore that includes the jumbee.

claims.statement: The people of the Congo speak of a nfumbi, an ancestral ghost, which could be related to the word "jumbie."
claims.statement_id: Orang Kongo menyebut nfumbi, hantu leluhur, yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kata "jumbie".
claims.quote: The people of the Congo speak of a nfumbi — ancestral ghost — which could be related to the word "jumbie."

claims.statement: The Étang Zombi in Guadeloupe owes its name to the legend of a slave owner's wife who was killed by her husband for trying to free his slaves and who now haunts the pond.
claims.statement_id: Étang Zombi di Guadeloupe mendapat namanya dari legenda istri seorang pemilik budak yang dibunuh suaminya karena berusaha membebaskan para budaknya dan kini menghantui kolam itu.
claims.quote: The Étang Zombi in Guadeloupe owes its name to the legend of the wife of a slave owner who was killed by her husband for trying to free his slaves and now haunts the pond.

claims.statement: The word is borrowed from Kongo zumbi ("fetish") and is a doublet of zombie.
claims.statement_id: Kata ini dipinjam dari kata Kongo zumbi ("fetish") dan merupakan kembaran etimologis kata zombie.
claims.quote: Borrowed from Kongo zumbi (“fetish”). Doublet of zombie.

claims.statement: Jumbie (plural jumbies) is chiefly Caribbean and means a ghost or evil spirit.
claims.statement_id: Jumbie (jamak jumbies) terutama dipakai di Karibia dan berarti hantu atau roh jahat.
claims.quote: jumbie (plural jumbies) (chiefly Caribbean) A ghost or evil spirit.

claims.statement: In this old account the believer at once explains that a jumbie can assume the shape of a tree, a rock or another natural object in order to escape detection.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan lama ini, orang yang percaya langsung menjelaskan bahwa jumbie dapat menyerupai pohon, batu, atau benda alam lain untuk menghindari terdeteksi.
claims.quote: or apparition, is a tree or rock or other natural object. He at once explains that a jumbie is able to assume these shapes to escape detection.

claims.statement: Ka'a Póra or Caapóra is a creature from the mythology of the Tupi tribes.
claims.statement_id: Ka'a Póra atau Caapóra adalah makhluk dari mitologi suku-suku Tupi.
claims.quote: La Ka'a Póra (en guaraní), Caapóra o Caá Póra es una criatura de la mitología de las tribus tupíes.

claims.statement: It is a ghost woman in the state of Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil) and in southern Paraguay, or an enormous man in northeastern Argentina.
claims.statement_id: Ia berwujud wanita hantu di negara bagian Rio Grande do Sul (Brasil) dan di selatan Paraguay, atau pria raksasa di timur laut Argentina.
claims.quote: Es una mujer fantasma en el estado de Rio Grande do Sul (Brasil), y en el sur del Paraguay o un hombre enorme en el Nordeste argentino.

claims.statement: Among non-Guaraní groups it is called Kripandufuá.
claims.statement_id: Di antara kelompok non-Guaraní, makhluk ini disebut Kripandufuá.
claims.quote: Entre los grupos no guaraníes, recibe el nombre de Kripandufuá.

claims.statement: Ka'a is translated as leaf, plant, forest or vegetation in general, and póra as ghost, so the name would mean ghost of the forest or forest spirit.
claims.statement_id: Ka'a diterjemahkan sebagai daun, tumbuhan, hutan, atau tetumbuhan pada umumnya, dan póra diterjemahkan sebagai hantu, sehingga nama itu berarti hantu hutan atau roh hutan.
claims.quote: ka'a se traduce al español como: hoja, planta, selva, vegetal en general; y póra (nombre de una leyenda paraguaya) se traduce como fantasma por lo que el nombre se significaría fantasma de la selva o espíritu del bosque.

claims.statement: The Ka'a Póra is portrayed as a woman, owner and protector of the forest animals. If she is on good terms with a hunter she can help him; if not, she will beat his dogs until they writhe in pain, using her invisibility, so that the prey escapes.
claims.statement_id: Ka'a Póra digambarkan sebagai wanita, pemilik dan pelindung hewan-hewan hutan. Jika berhubungan baik dengan seorang pemburu, ia dapat membantunya; jika tidak, ia akan memukuli anjing-anjing pemburu itu sampai menggeliat kesakitan dengan memanfaatkan ketakkasatmataannya, sehingga buruan lolos.
claims.quote: La Ka'a Póra es representada como una mujer, dueña y protectora de los animales del monte. Si está en buenas relaciones con un cazador, puede ayudarlo. Si no lo está, apaleará sus perros hasta hacerlos revolcarse de dolor aprovechando su invisibilidad, y permitiendo así que la presa huya.

claims.statement: According to Ambrosetti, in the province of Río Grande del Sur the Caá-Porá is also a woman: the owner of all the forest animals, a kind of Diana, who gives a hunter she favours the means to find prey.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ambrosetti, di provinsi Río Grande del Sur, Caá-Porá juga seorang wanita: pemilik semua hewan hutan, sejenis Diana, yang memudahkan pemburu yang disukainya menemukan buruan.
claims.quote: En la provincia de Río Grande del Sur, la Caá ... Porá es también una mujer: la dueña de todos los animales del monte, una especie de Diana que, cuando el cazador le cae en gracia, le facilita los medios de encontrar la presa

claims.statement: In the province of Paraná, according to Ambrosetti, the Caá-Porá is a hairy, gigantic man with a large head.
claims.statement_id: Di provinsi Paraná, menurut Ambrosetti, Caá-Porá adalah pria berbulu lebat, bertubuh raksasa, dan berkepala besar.
claims.quote: la provincia del Paraná, la Caá-Porá es un hombre velludo, gigantesco, de gran cabeza

claims.statement: In a legend recorded by Ambrosetti, when people find a herd of wild pigs and wipe it out, the Caá-Porá appears to them riding the last pig, and at the sight the killers are left dazed for life.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda yang dicatat Ambrosetti, ketika orang menemukan sekawanan babi hutan dan membasminya, Caá-Porá menampakkan diri menunggangi babi terakhir, dan melihatnya membuat para pembunuh itu linglung seumur hidup.
claims.quote: Cuando encuentran una piara de cerdos silvestres ... se les aparece, montado en el último cerdo, el Caá-Porá ... a cuya vista los matadores quedan idiotizados para toda la vida

claims.statement: For others the Caá-Porá is also a hairy man who smokes a pipe made from a human skull and a tibia, and devours people.
claims.statement_id: Bagi sebagian orang lain, Caá-Porá adalah pria berbulu lebat yang mengisap pipa dari tengkorak manusia dan tulang kering, dan melahap orang.
claims.quote: Para otros el Caá-Porá es también un hombre velludo que fuma en una pipa formada por un cráneo humano y una tibia, y devora a la gente

claims.statement: In other accounts it becomes simply Porá, a ghost that appears in the shape of a pig or a dog and spits flames from its mouth, frightening the animals.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penuturan lain, ia menjadi sekadar Porá, hantu yang menampakkan diri dalam wujud babi atau anjing dan menyemburkan api dari mulutnya sehingga menakuti hewan-hewan.
claims.quote: simple Porá, o fantasma que se aparece en el ... ya sea en forma de cerdo o perro, y lanzando llamas por la boca, asustando así a los animales.

claims.statement: Ambrosetti also recorded a legend that refers to the Caá-Porá but under the name Petey, that is, "One".
claims.statement_id: Ambrosetti juga mencatat sebuah legenda yang merujuk pada Caá-Porá tetapi dengan nama Petey, yaitu "Satu".
claims.quote: se refiere a la Caá-Porá; pero bajo el nombre de Petey, es decir, Uno.

claims.statement: Ambrosetti writes that the Caá Yarí is one of many genius loci that, like the Caá-Porá, could belong to the same group as the Pacha-Mama.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Ambrosetti, Caá Yarí adalah salah satu dari banyak genius loci yang, seperti Caá-Porá, mungkin termasuk dalam kelompok yang sama dengan Pacha-Mama.
claims.quote: La Caá Yarí es uno de tantos genius loci que, como la Caá-Porá, podrían pertenecer al mismo grupo que la Pacha-Mama

claims.statement: Ambrosetti suggests that the overexcited imagination of woodsmen must give human forms to tree trunks.
claims.statement_id: Ambrosetti berpendapat bahwa imajinasi para penghuni hutan yang terlalu bersemangat memberi bentuk manusia pada batang-batang pohon.
claims.quote: La imaginación exaltada de los montaraces ha de dar formas humanas a troncos de árboles

claims.statement: Kasogonagá (also spelled Gasogonaga, Qasoxonaxa and many other variations) is a Toba weather goddess.
claims.statement_id: Kasogonagá (juga dieja Gasogonaga, Qasoxonaxa, dan banyak variasi lain) adalah dewi cuaca suku Toba.
claims.quote: Kasogonagá (also spelled as Gasogonaga, Qasoxonaxa, and many other variations) is a Toba weather goddess.

claims.statement: She appears to shamans (pio’oxonak) in visions induced by psychoactive plants.
claims.statement_id: Ia menampakkan diri kepada dukun (pio’oxonak) dalam penglihatan yang dipicu tumbuhan psikoaktif.
claims.quote: She appears to shamans, or pio’oxonak, in visions induced by psychoactive plants

claims.statement: She is described as a colorful animal with a mouth that shoots lightning.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan sebagai hewan berwarna-warni dengan mulut yang memancarkan petir.
claims.quote: described as a colorful animal with a mouth that shoots lightning.

claims.statement: According to some Toba people, Kasogonagá appears as a multicolored elephant that throws lightning from her mouth; these attributes are related to rain and rainbows.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sebagian orang Toba, Kasogonagá tampil sebagai gajah berwarna-warni yang melontarkan petir dari mulutnya; ciri-ciri ini dikaitkan dengan hujan dan pelangi.
claims.quote: According to some members of the Toba people, Kasogonagá appears as a multicolored elephant that throws lightning from her mouth. These attributes are related to the rain and rainbows.

claims.statement: Kasogonagá is also described as an anteater that lives in the sky, and sometimes she is said to be a pig.
claims.statement_id: Kasogonagá juga digambarkan sebagai beruang semut (anteater) yang hidup di langit, dan kadang dikatakan seekor babi.
claims.quote: Alternatively, Kasogonagá is also described as an anteater that lives in the sky. Sometimes she is even said to be a pig.

claims.statement: In one myth Kasogonagá asks a man to build a bonfire so that she can ride its smoke back to the sky; in gratitude she makes it rain and tells the man he can ask her for anything he needs.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu mitos, Kasogonagá meminta seorang pria membuat api unggun agar ia dapat menunggangi asapnya kembali ke langit; sebagai tanda terima kasih ia menurunkan hujan dan berkata kepada pria itu bahwa ia boleh meminta apa pun.
claims.quote: She asked the man to build a bonfire so that she could ride the smoke and return to the sky. The man did as she asked, and placed her on top of the bonfire. In her gratitude, she made it rain, and told the man that if he needed anything, he could just ask her.

claims.statement: In an account recorded by Terán, Kasogonaga is the lightning but also a small animal; it takes the form of a four-legged little animal and is the owner of the lightning.
claims.statement_id: Dalam penuturan yang dicatat Terán, Kasogonaga adalah petir sekaligus hewan kecil; ia berwujud hewan kecil berkaki empat dan pemilik petir.
claims.quote: Kasogonaga es el rayo, pero también es un animalito. Toma la forma de un animalito de cuatro patas. Es el dueño del rayo.

claims.statement: The Toba say that a man in the bush heard someone calling him and found Kasogonaga in the form of a small pig that had fallen from a cloud.
claims.statement_id: Orang Toba menuturkan bahwa seorang pria di hutan mendengar panggilan dan mendapati Kasogonaga berwujud babi kecil yang jatuh dari awan.
claims.quote: Los Toba dicen que un día un hombre estaba afuera en el monte y escuchó alguien que lo llamaba. Miró quién era y allí estaba Kasogonaga bajo la forma de un pequeño cerdo que se había caído de una nube.

claims.statement: In those accounts this celestial being is associated with rain, thunder and lightning; as owner of these atmospheric phenomena, qasoxonaxa can help people in droughts and floods.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah-kisah itu, makhluk langit tersebut dikaitkan dengan hujan, guntur, dan kilat; sebagai pemilik gejala cuaca itu, qasoxonaxa dapat menolong manusia ketika kemarau dan banjir.
claims.quote: En ellos, se observa también una asociación entre dicho ser celestial y la lluvia, los truenos y relámpagos; como dueño de tales fenómenos atmosféricos, qasoxonaxa puede ayudar a los seres humanos ante situaciones de sequía e inundaciones.

claims.statement: In Sarra's records from the qom neighbourhood of Derqui, the being is conceived as a sky elephant, a small animal or an anteater, owner of rain and thunder, that lives in the sky above the clouds.
claims.statement_id: Dalam catatan Sarra di lingkungan qom di Derqui, makhluk ini dibayangkan sebagai gajah langit, hewan kecil, atau beruang semut, pemilik atau penguasa hujan dan guntur yang tinggal di langit di atas awan.
claims.quote: En los relatos, situaciones fragmentarias y dibujos que registré en el barrio qom de Derqui, dicho ser es conceptualizado como un elefante del cielo, como un pequeño animalito o como un oso hormiguero, dueño o dueña de la lluvia y los truenos, que habita en el cielo sobre las nubes

claims.statement: The differing descriptions may be due to the metamorphic logic of the qom conception of person and body, which allows different states of one and the same being.
claims.statement_id: Beragam deskripsi itu mungkin disebabkan oleh logika metamorfik dalam pandangan qom tentang pribadi dan tubuh, yang mengizinkan beberapa keadaan bagi satu makhluk yang sama.
claims.quote: Las diversas descripciones pueden deberse a la lógica metamórfica de la concepción qom de la persona y el cuerpo, que permite diferentes estados de un mismo ser

claims.statement: In brief, in those accounts the being has its dwelling in the heavens but can occasionally fall to the earth, and then needs human help to return.
claims.statement_id: Secara ringkas, dalam kisah-kisah itu makhluk ini bertempat tinggal di langit tetapi sewaktu-waktu dapat jatuh ke bumi, lalu memerlukan bantuan manusia untuk kembali.
claims.quote: Sintéticamente, en dichos relatos se describe que dicho ser tiene su morada en los cielos pero eventualmente puede caer al plano terrestre, y entonces necesita de la ayuda de los seres humanos para regresar.

claims.statement: In the first two accounts people helped it up to the sky by building a large fire; in return qasoxonaxa will help them in droughts or floods.
claims.statement_id: Dalam dua kisah pertama, manusia menolongnya naik ke langit dengan membuat api besar; sebagai balasan, qasoxonaxa akan menolong mereka ketika kemarau atau banjir.
claims.quote: éstos lo ayudaron a subir al cielo mediante la construcción de un gran fuego; a cambio, qasoxonaxa les ofrecerá ayuda ante sequías o inundaciones

claims.statement: A girl in Derqui told Sarra that her grandmother, an elephant in the sky, cures warts, and that when it rains one must put out a hand so that the rain water, together with the appropriate prayers, takes effect.
claims.statement_id: Seorang anak di Derqui berkata kepada Sarra bahwa neneknya, seekor gajah di langit, menyembuhkan kutil, dan bahwa saat hujan tangan harus dijulurkan agar air hujan bersama doa-doa yang sesuai bekerja.
claims.quote: mi abuela que es un elefante que está en el cielo cura verrugas ... cuando llueve hay que sacar la mano para que el contacto con el agua de la lluvia, junto con los rezos correspondientes, haga su efecto.

claims.statement: The mountain qasoxonaxa is situated in the west.
claims.statement_id: Gunung qasoxonaxa terletak di barat.
claims.quote: La montaña qasoxonaxa se sitúa al oeste

claims.statement: La Condená is the name by which a female malevolent being of Chilote mythology in Chile is described.
claims.statement_id: La Condená adalah nama untuk makhluk jahat perempuan dalam mitologi Chiloé di Chile.
claims.quote: La Condená es el nombre con el cual se describe a un ser maligno femenino de la mitología chilota en Chile.

claims.statement: La Condená is described as a middle-aged woman of about forty to fifty who was very beautiful in her youth but, because of her bad life, is condemned to bear a human form that is a grotesque mixture.
claims.statement_id: La Condená digambarkan sebagai wanita paruh baya sekitar empat puluh hingga lima puluh tahun yang semasa muda sangat cantik, tetapi karena hidupnya yang buruk terkutuk membawa wujud manusia yang merupakan campuran ganjil.
claims.quote: La Condená se describe como una mujer de mediana edad de alrededor de cuarenta a cincuenta años; que durante su juventud fue muy hermosa, pero por causa de su mala vida está condenada a llevar una forma humana que representa una mezcla grotesca

claims.statement: She was condemned to wander all the roads, dragging along the guilt of a licentious and immoral existence.
claims.statement_id: Ia dihukum mengembara di semua jalan sambil menanggung kesalahan karena hidup yang bejat dan tak bermoral.
claims.quote: se le condenó a vagar por todos los caminos, arrastrando consigo las culpas de haber tenido una existencia licenciosa e inmoral.

claims.statement: She managed to attract the attention of the Trauco to have relations with him; she is better known as the mother of the Fiura, who is the wife of her own father, the Trauco.
claims.statement_id: Ia berhasil menarik perhatian Trauco untuk berhubungan dengannya; ia lebih dikenal sebagai ibu Fiura, yang adalah istri ayahnya sendiri, Trauco.
claims.quote: ella logró atraer la atención del Trauco para tener relaciones con él. De esta forma, la Condená logró que germinara en ella la semilla de la perversión de sus actos; y se le conozca más como la madre de la Fiura la cual es esposa de su padre el Trauco.

claims.statement: The word condená is a synonym of condenada and is used for people who stray from moral conduct and a proper life.
claims.statement_id: Kata condená bersinonim dengan condenada dan dipakai untuk menyebut orang yang menyimpang dari perilaku moral dan kehidupan yang pantas.
claims.quote: La palabra condená, es un sinónimo de la palabra condenada, que es usada para referirse a personas, que se apartan de una conducta moral y vida adecuada

claims.statement: According to Quintana Mansilla, unrestrained pleasures and vices, which bring moral degradation and the disintegration of the human personality, have their genuine representative in Chilote mythology.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Quintana Mansilla, kenikmatan tanpa batas dan kebejatan, yang membawa kemerosotan moral dan runtuhnya kepribadian manusia, mempunyai wakil sejatinya dalam mitologi Chiloé.
claims.quote: Los placeres desenfrenados y los vicios, que traen consigo la degradación moral y la desintegración de la personalidad humana, tienen también su genuino representante en la mitología chilota

claims.statement: The myth describes her as a middle-aged woman who was very beautiful in adolescence and youth but, in the maturity of her wretched existence, shows a grotesque mixture of the alluring, the withered and the disfigured by the deep, indelible marks of a dissipated life.
claims.statement_id: Mitos menggambarkannya sebagai wanita paruh baya yang sangat cantik di masa remaja dan mudanya, tetapi pada usia matang hidupnya yang malang menunjukkan campuran ganjil antara yang memikat, yang layu, dan yang rusak oleh bekas-bekas mendalam kehidupan yang bejat.
claims.quote: El mito, la describe como una mujer de mediana edad, que fue muy hermosa en su adolescencia y juventud, pero en la madurez de su lamentable existencia, muestra una mezcla grotesca de una insinuante, con lo mustio, y lo desfigurado por las huellas profundas e indelebles, que imprime la vida disipada

claims.statement: In her withered womb this spirit of evil took root, giving rise to a deformed and highly perverse creature who at birth was named Fiura.
claims.statement_id: Dalam rahimnya yang layu tumbuh roh jahat itu, melahirkan makhluk cacat dan sangat jahat yang saat lahir diberi nama Fiura.
claims.quote: En las entrañas marchitas de esta eximia inventora y cultora de todos los vicios, de múltiples placeres exóticos, perversiones y excesos de toda índole, germinó este espíritu del mal, dando origen a una criatura deforme y altamente perversa, digna descendiente de una madre depravada y que a su nacimiento recibió el nombre de Fiura.

claims.statement: Although the myth has faded, the word "condená" is still used fairly often for people who stray from the clear and straight line of proper moral conduct.
claims.statement_id: Meskipun mitosnya kini memudar, kata "condená" masih cukup sering dipakai untuk menyebut orang yang menyimpang dari garis perilaku moral yang lurus.
claims.quote: la palabra “condená”, continúa usándose con cierta frecuencia y precisamente, para referirse a personas, que se apartan de la línea clara y recta de una conducta moral adecuada

claims.statement: Quintana Mansilla says the personality of La Condená has certain points of contact with the goddess Aphrodite of European mythology.
claims.statement_id: Quintana Mansilla menilai kepribadian La Condená memiliki beberapa kesamaan dengan dewi Afrodita dari mitologi Eropa.
claims.quote: La personalidad de la Condená, tiene ciertos puntos de contacto, con la diosa Afrodita, de la mitología europea

claims.statement: Quintana Mansilla writes that this myth now lies erased by the patina of time.
claims.statement_id: Quintana Mansilla menulis bahwa mitos ini kini terkubur, terhapus oleh patina waktu.
claims.quote: Si bien este mito, yace en la actualidad, borrado por la pátina del tiempo
