claims.statement: Lang Bobi Suzi is a legend from the Kriol folklore of Belize.
claims.statement_id: Lang Bobi Suzi adalah legenda dari cerita rakyat Kriol di Belize.
claims.quote: Lang Bobi Suzi is a legend from the Kriol folklore of Belize.

claims.statement: According to the legend, Lang Bobi Suzi is a female monster.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Lang Bobi Suzi adalah monster perempuan.
claims.quote: According to the legend, Lang Bobi Suzi is a female monster

claims.statement: She whips naughty children with her giant breasts if they refuse to do her bidding.
claims.statement_id: Ia mencambuk anak-anak nakal dengan payudaranya yang raksasa jika mereka menolak menuruti perintahnya.
claims.quote: whips naughty children with her giant breasts if they refuse to do her bidding.

claims.statement: Japanese Wikipedia writes the creature's name in katakana (ラング・ボビ・スジ) and gives the English form Long-Bubby Suzie; it describes a female monster of Belizean Creole tradition.
claims.statement_id: Wikipedia bahasa Jepang menulis nama makhluk ini dalam katakana (ラング・ボビ・スジ) dan memberi padanan Inggris Long-Bubby Suzie; ia disebut monster perempuan dalam tradisi kreol Belize.
claims.quote: ラング・ボビ・スジ（Lang Bobi Suzi, 英: Long-Bubby Suzie）は、ベリーズのクレオール伝承で語られる女性の怪物。

claims.statement: Mama D'Leau derives from the French Maman de l'eau, "Mother of the River", and is also known as Mama Dlo and Mama Glo.
claims.statement_id: Mama D'Leau berasal dari bahasa Prancis Maman de l'eau, "Ibu Sungai", dan dikenal juga sebagai Mama Dlo dan Mama Glo.
claims.quote: Mama D'Leau (derived from the French Maman de l'eau or "Mother of the River"), also known as Mama Dlo and Mama Glo

claims.statement: According to the folklore of islands such as Saint Lucia, Trinidad and Tobago and Dominica, she is the protector and healer of all river animals.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita rakyat pulau-pulau seperti Saint Lucia, Trinidad dan Tobago, dan Dominica, ia pelindung dan penyembuh semua hewan sungai.
claims.quote: is the protector and healer of all river animals, according to the folklore of islands such as Saint Lucia, Trinidad and Tobago and Dominica.

claims.statement: She is usually depicted as a beautiful woman with long hair whose body twists into coils from the waist downwards.
claims.statement_id: Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai wanita cantik berambut panjang yang dari pinggang ke bawah melingkar seperti ular.
claims.quote: She is usually depicted as a beautiful woman with long hair, who sits on upper body and arms and from her waist downwards twists into coils.

claims.statement: Her tongue becomes forked and she holds a golden comb that she passes through her snaky hair.
claims.statement_id: Lidahnya menjadi bercabang dan ia memegang sisir emas yang ia sisirkan pada rambutnya yang seperti ular.
claims.quote: Her tongue becomes forked and she holds a golden comb which she passes through her snaky hair.

claims.statement: According to Martin, the French Patwa term Mama-Glo/Mama-Dlo derives from maman de l'eau, "water mother", but is a derivative of Mami-Wata, a river goddess or spirit found throughout West Africa, and also incorporates similar Amerindian beliefs.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Martin, istilah Patwa Prancis Mama-Glo/Mama-Dlo berasal dari maman de l'eau, "ibu air", tetapi merupakan turunan Mami-Wata, dewi atau roh sungai di seluruh Afrika Barat, dan juga memuat kepercayaan Amerindian yang serupa.
claims.quote: The French Patwa term Mama-Glo/Mama-Dlo is derived from the French maman de l’eau: “water mother,” but is a derivative of the Mami-Wata, a river goddess/spirit found throughout Western Africa, and also incorporates similar Amerindian beliefs.

claims.statement: The spirit is described variously as a beautiful woman, a mermaid or an unattractive old woman who can be generous yet deadly if ignored or disobeyed.
claims.statement_id: Roh ini digambarkan beragam: wanita cantik, putri duyung, atau perempuan tua yang tidak menarik, yang bisa murah hati tetapi mematikan jika diabaikan atau tidak dituruti.
claims.quote: The spirit has been variously described as a beautiful woman, a mermaid, or an unattractive old woman who can be generous, yet deadly if ignored or disobeyed.

claims.statement: She has a human head, but her lower half can be fish-like or a large snake, which she can use to strangle her victims.
claims.statement_id: Kepalanya manusia, tetapi tubuh bagian bawahnya dapat menyerupai ikan atau ular besar yang bisa ia pakai untuk mencekik korbannya.
claims.quote: She has a human head, but her lower half can be fish-like (similar to the European mermaid), or a large snake (derived from its West African progenitor), which she can use to strangle her victims.

claims.statement: The Mama-Glo has been blamed for people disappearing by drowning, usually men who may have spurned her love; she is believed to force anyone who looks at her to do menial tasks such as scratching her back or collecting fallen leaves.
claims.statement_id: Mama-Glo dipersalahkan atas hilangnya orang karena tenggelam, biasanya pria yang mungkin menolak cintanya; diyakini ia memaksa siapa pun yang menatapnya mengerjakan tugas-tugas remeh seperti menggaruk punggungnya atau memungut daun gugur.
claims.quote: The Mama-Glo has been blamed for the disappearance by drowning of individuals, usually men who may have spurned her love. It is believed that she will force anyone who looks at her to perform menial tasks like scratching her back or collecting fallen leaves.

claims.statement: As the mother of the water, Shango worshippers and certain Spiritual Baptist sects revere(d) her and make/made offerings to her at lakes, rivers and hot springs.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai ibu air, para penyembah Shango dan sejumlah sekte Spiritual Baptist menghormatinya dan mempersembahkan sesaji kepadanya di danau, sungai, dan mata air panas.
claims.quote: As the mother of the water, Shango worshippers and certain Spiritual Baptist sects regard(ed) her with reverence and made/make offerings to her at lakes, rivers and hot springs.

claims.statement: Martin writes that the Mama Glo combines the European mermaid with the African river goddess, as its diverse characteristics illustrate.
claims.statement_id: Martin menulis bahwa Mama Glo memadukan putri duyung Eropa dengan dewi sungai Afrika, seperti tampak dari beragam cirinya.
claims.quote: The Mama Glo combines the European mermaid with the African river goddess as illustrated by its diverse characteristics.

claims.statement: Martin calls the Mama Glo a syncretic or Creole creation, like La Diablesse, Soucouyant, Dwenn, Mama Maladie and Papa Bwa, that is unique to Grenadian (and Caribbean) folk culture.
claims.statement_id: Martin menyebut Mama Glo sebagai ciptaan sinkretis atau Kreol, seperti La Diablesse, Soucouyant, Dwenn, Mama Maladie, dan Papa Bwa, yang khas bagi budaya rakyat Grenada (dan Karibia).
claims.quote: it is a syncretic/Creole creation like La diablesse, Soucouyant, Dwenn, Mama Maladie and Papa Bwa that’s unique to Grenadian (and Caribbean) folk culture

claims.statement: A National Library of Jamaica record catalogues a print from the series "The Spirit of Trinidad - folklore" describing Mama d'glo as a legendary Trinidad character.
claims.statement_id: Katalog Perpustakaan Nasional Jamaika memuat cetakan dari seri "The Spirit of Trinidad - folklore" yang menyebut Mama d'glo sebagai tokoh legenda Trinidad.
claims.quote: The Spirit of Trinidad - folklore series No. 5. Mama d'glo, legendary Trinidad character.

claims.statement: Maushop or Moshup is a mythical hero and giant from Wampanoag folklore.
claims.statement_id: Maushop atau Moshup adalah pahlawan mitos dan raksasa dalam cerita rakyat Wampanoag.
claims.quote: Maushop or Moshup ... is a mythical hero and giant from Wampanoag folklore.

claims.statement: According to legend, he came from Aquinnah on Martha's Vineyard and lived there from before the Wampanoag.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, ia berasal dari Aquinnah di Martha's Vineyard dan tinggal di sana sejak sebelum orang Wampanoag.
claims.quote: According to legend, he came from Aquinnah on Martha's Vineyard and lived there from before the Wampanoag.

claims.statement: Maushop was seen as a provider for the Wampanoag, teaching them how to hunt and fish.
claims.statement_id: Maushop dipandang sebagai penyedia kebutuhan orang Wampanoag, mengajari mereka berburu dan memancing.
claims.quote: Maushop was seen as a provider for the Wampanoag, teaching them how to hunt and fish.

claims.statement: Maushop was so large that his diet consisted mainly of whales; to catch them he threw boulders into the water as stepping stones, and the ashes he emptied from his pipe into the ocean at a celebration became Nantucket.
claims.statement_id: Maushop begitu besar sehingga makanannya sebagian besar paus; untuk menangkapnya ia melempar batu besar ke air sebagai pijakan, dan abu pipanya yang ia buang ke laut saat perayaan menjadi Nantucket.
claims.quote: Maushop was so large that his diet consisted mainly of whales. To catch them, he threw boulders into the water to make stepping stones. During a celebration, he emptied his pipe ashes into the ocean, and they became Nantucket.

claims.statement: In one story a crab bites his toe, making him stomp around and leave large footprints in the ground.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu cerita, seekor kepiting menggigit jempol kakinya sehingga ia menghentak-hentak dan meninggalkan jejak kaki besar di tanah.
claims.quote: At one point, a crab bites his toe causing him to stomp around, leaving large footprints in the ground.

claims.statement: The Wampanoag apparently became too reliant on him, so he left so that they would learn to survive on their own.
claims.statement_id: Orang Wampanoag konon terlalu bergantung padanya, sehingga ia pergi agar mereka belajar bertahan hidup sendiri.
claims.quote: The Wampanoag apparently became too reliant on him, so he left so they would learn how to survive on their own.

claims.statement: He is said to have several companions, including a giant frog and his wife Granny Squannit.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikatakan memiliki beberapa pendamping, termasuk katak raksasa dan istrinya, Granny Squannit.
claims.quote: He is said to have several companions, including a giant frog and his wife Granny Squannit.

claims.statement: The tribe believes Moshup is responsible for the present shapes of Martha's Vineyard, the Elizabeth Islands, Noman's Land and Nantucket; he is a benevolent being of gigantic frame and supernatural power, sometimes thought of as the devil by those who did not understand him.
claims.statement_id: Suku Wampanoag Aquinnah percaya Moshup bertanggung jawab atas bentuk Martha's Vineyard, Kepulauan Elizabeth, Noman's Land, dan Nantucket; ia makhluk baik hati bertubuh raksasa dan berkekuatan gaib, yang kadang dianggap iblis oleh orang yang tidak memahaminya.
claims.quote: Moshup is believed by our tribe to be responsible for the present shapes of Martha's Vineyard, the Elizabeth Islands, Noman's Land, and Nantucket. He is a benevolent being of gigantic frame and supernatural power. He was sometimes thought of as the devil by those who did not understand him.

claims.statement: Moshup's favorite daily food was a broiled whale, usually eaten whole at one meal; he also threw many whales onto the coast for the Wampanoag's supper.
claims.statement_id: Makanan harian kesukaan Moshup adalah paus panggang yang biasanya ia habiskan utuh dalam sekali makan; ia juga melemparkan banyak paus ke pantai untuk santapan orang Wampanoag.
claims.quote: Moshup's favorite daily food was a broiled whale, which he usually ate whole at a meal. He also threw many whales on the coast for the supper of the Wampanoag.

claims.statement: From near the entrance to his den on the Aquinnah Cliffs, Moshup would wade into the ocean, pick up a whale, fling it against the Cliffs to kill it and cook it over the fire that burned continually.
claims.statement_id: Dari dekat pintu sarangnya di Tebing Aquinnah, Moshup berjalan ke laut, mengangkat seekor paus, membantingnya ke tebing hingga mati, lalu memasaknya di atas api yang tak pernah padam.
claims.quote: From near the entrance to his den on the Aquinnah Cliffs, Moshup would wade into the ocean, pick up a whale, fling it against the Cliffs to kill it, and then cook it over the fire that burned continually.

claims.statement: The coals of the largest trees he plucked up by the roots, the whale bones, shark's teeth and petrified quahogs still found in the Cliffs are the refuse from Moshup's table.
claims.statement_id: Bara dari pohon-pohon terbesar yang ia cabut hingga akarnya, tulang paus, gigi hiu, dan kerang quahog yang membatu yang masih ditemukan di tebing itu adalah sisa dari meja makan Moshup.
claims.quote: The coals of the largest trees (which Moshup plucked up by the roots), the bones of the whales, shark's teeth, and petrified quahogs that are still found today in the Cliffs are the refuse from Moshup's table.

claims.statement: A tribal member quoted on the tribe's official site says Moshup was the first schoolmaster, who from his home on the Cliffs taught the people respect.
claims.statement_id: Seorang anggota suku, yang dikutip situs resmi suku, mengatakan bahwa Moshup adalah guru sekolah pertama yang dari rumahnya di tebing mengajarkan rasa hormat kepada orang-orang.
claims.quote: Moshup was the first schoolmaster. From his home on the Cliffs he taught the people respect

claims.statement: It is said that a benevolent being named Moshup roamed the land; one day, crossing the mainland to the headlands of the Aquinnah Cliffs, he dragged his weary foot and left a deep track in the mud.
claims.statement_id: Dikatakan, makhluk baik hati bernama Moshup berkelana di tanah itu; suatu hari ia menyeberangi daratan menuju tanjung Tebing Aquinnah dan, karena lelah, menyeret kakinya hingga meninggalkan jejak dalam di lumpur.
claims.quote: There, it is said, a benevolent being named Moshup roamed the land. One day, Moshup was making his way across the mainland to the headlands of the Aquinnah Cliffs. Weary from his journey, Moshup dragged his foot heavily, leaving a deep track in the mud.

claims.statement: Gradually the force of wind and tides broadened and deepened the opening, creating an island named Noepe.
claims.statement_id: Perlahan, kekuatan angin dan pasang laut melebarkan dan memperdalam alur jejak itu sehingga terbentuk pulau bernama Noepe.
claims.quote: But gradually, the ocean's force of wind and tides broadened and deepened the opening, creating an island named Noepe.

claims.statement: The Aquinnah Wampanoag share the belief that the giant Moshup created Noepe and the neighboring islands, taught their people to fish and catch whales, and still presides over their destinies.
claims.statement_id: Orang Wampanoag Aquinnah bersama-sama meyakini bahwa raksasa Moshup menciptakan Noepe dan pulau-pulau di sekitarnya, mengajari mereka menangkap ikan dan paus, dan masih menjaga nasib mereka.
claims.quote: The Aquinnah Wampanoag share the belief that the giant Moshup created Noepe and the neighboring islands, taught our people how to fish and to catch whales, and still presides over our destinies.

claims.statement: Millalobo is an important being in Chilote mythology; his name comes from Mapudungun milla ("gold") and Spanish lobo, alluding to the sea lion.
claims.statement_id: Millalobo adalah makhluk penting dalam mitologi Chiloé; namanya berasal dari milla ("emas") dalam bahasa Mapudungun dan lobo dalam bahasa Spanyol, yang menyinggung singa laut.
claims.quote: Millalobo (from the mapudungun milla: "gold" and the Spanish lobo: wolf in allusion to the sea lion) is an important being in Chilote mythology

claims.statement: The Millalobo is a being like a Triton, with the lower half a sea lion and the upper half human, and a face that mixes both.
claims.statement_id: Millalobo adalah makhluk mirip Triton: separuh bawah singa laut dan separuh atas manusia, dengan wajah campuran keduanya.
claims.quote: The Millalobo is a being like a Triton, lower half sea lion and upper half human, his face a mixture of both.

claims.statement: He was born from the mating of a woman and a sea lion that saved her from drowning, at the time of the mythical battle between Tenten Vilu and Caicai Vilu.
claims.statement_id: Ia lahir dari perkawinan seorang wanita dengan singa laut yang menyelamatkannya dari tenggelam, pada masa pertempuran mitos antara Tenten Vilu dan Caicai Vilu.
claims.quote: He was born from the mating between a woman and a sea lion who saved her from drowning, at the time of the mythical battle between Tenten Vilu and Caicai Vilu.

claims.statement: He is the most powerful being of the sea after Caicai and was chosen by Caicai as his representative to govern all that lived in the sea.
claims.statement_id: Ia makhluk laut paling berkuasa setelah Caicai dan dipilih Caicai sebagai wakilnya untuk memerintah semua yang tinggal di laut.
claims.quote: He is the most powerful being of the sea after Caicai and was chosen by Caicai to be his representative and govern all that resided in the sea.

claims.statement: His fur is golden, hence his name; he is said to be unable to talk and to communicate only through a bleat like a sea lion's, whose meaning human beings can understand.
claims.statement_id: Bulunya keemasan, sehingga ia dinamai demikian; konon ia tidak dapat bicara dan hanya berkomunikasi lewat embikan mirip singa laut, yang artinya dapat dipahami manusia.
claims.quote: The Millalobo's fur is golden, hence his name. It is said that this mythical being cannot talk and he can only communicate through a bleat similar to the sea lion's, even though, the meaning of his bleat is understandable to human beings.

claims.statement: The Millalobo lives at the bottom of the sea with his wife Huenchula and their three children, the Pincoya, the Pincoy and La Sirena Chilota, who help him manage the seas.
claims.statement_id: Millalobo tinggal di dasar laut bersama istrinya, Huenchula, dan ketiga anak mereka, La Pincoya, El Pincoy, dan La Sirena Chilota, yang membantunya mengelola laut.
claims.quote: The Millalobo lives at the bottom of the sea, together with his wife Huenchula and their three children, The Pincoya, The Pincoy and La Sirena Chilota, who help him in his task of managing the seas.

claims.statement: The Millalobo is the creator of the ghost ship known as the Caleuche, and evil as well as benevolent sea creatures are said to pay him respect.
claims.statement_id: Millalobo disebut pencipta kapal hantu Caleuche, dan makhluk laut jahat maupun baik konon harus menghormatinya.
claims.quote: The Millalobo is the creator of the ghost ship known as Caleuche. It is said that evil sea creatures must pay respect to the Millalobo as well as benevolent ones.

claims.statement: According to Quintana Mansilla, the Millalobo lives in the depths of the sea and was conceived by a beautiful woman in love with a sea lion.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Quintana Mansilla, Millalobo tinggal di kedalaman laut dan dikandung oleh seorang wanita cantik yang berhubungan dengan seekor singa laut.
claims.quote: El Millalobo, es un destacado personaje que habita en lo más profundo del mar; fue concebido por una hermosa mujer en amores con un lobo marino

claims.statement: Quintana Mansilla writes that the Millalobo was invested by Coicoi-vilu as absolute owner of the seas and everything in them.
claims.statement_id: Quintana Mansilla menulis bahwa Millalobo diangkat oleh Coicoi-vilu sebagai pemilik mutlak lautan dan segala isinya.
claims.quote: El Millalobo, fue investido por Coicoi-vilu, como dueño absoluto de los mares y de todo lo en ellos está comprendido.

claims.statement: He is described as a strange being the size of a large seal, with a face resembling both a man's and a fish's; the chest looks human and the rest of the body has unmistakable sea-lion forms.
claims.statement_id: Ia digambarkan sebagai makhluk aneh seukuran anjing laut besar, berwajah mirip manusia sekaligus ikan; bagian dada tampak manusia dan sisa tubuhnya berbentuk singa laut yang tak salah lagi.
claims.quote: Se le describe como un extraño ser, del tamaño de una foca grande, con el rostro parecido al de un hombre y al de un pez al mismo tiempo. La parte del tórax tiene aspecto humano, el resto de su cuerpo, tiene inconfundibles formas de lobo marino.

claims.statement: He is covered in short, shiny, gold-yellow fur, hence his name Millalobo (milla = gold) or "golden wolf".
claims.statement_id: Tubuhnya tertutup bulu pendek mengilap berwarna kuning emas, dan dari situlah namanya, Millalobo (milla = emas) atau "serigala emas".
claims.quote: Está cubierto de un corto y brillante pelaje, color amarillo oro, de ahí su nombre de Millalobo (de milla=oro) o lobo de oro.

claims.statement: He is the absolute master of all the seas and the supreme chief of the real or imaginary beings that inhabit them.
claims.statement_id: Ia pemilik mutlak semua lautan dan pemimpin tertinggi makhluk nyata maupun khayalan yang mendiaminya.
claims.quote: Es el amo absoluto de todos los mares y el jefe supremo de los seres reales o imaginarios que en ellos habitan.

claims.statement: He shares his life with the beautiful Huenchula, daughter of an old sorceress called "la Huenchur"; three children were born of this union: the Pincoya, the Sirena and the Pincoy.
claims.statement_id: Ia hidup bersama Huenchula yang cantik, putri seorang penyihir tua bernama "la Huenchur"; dari ikatan itu lahir tiga anak: la Pincoya, la Sirena, dan el Pincoy.
claims.quote: Comparte su vida con la bella Huenchula, la hija de una vieja hechicera, llamada “la Huenchur”. De esta unión nacieron tres hijos: la Pincoya, la Sirena y el Pincoy.

claims.statement: As lord and master he delegates his important functions to several subordinates, from seeding fish and shellfish and tending their growth and multiplication to directing the tides or controlling calms and storms.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai penguasa, ia mendelegasikan tugas-tugas pentingnya kepada bawahan, dari menyebar ikan dan kerang serta merawat perkembangbiakannya hingga mengarahkan pasang surut dan mengendalikan laut tenang dan badai.
claims.quote: Como dueño y señor, de gran poderío, delega sus importantes funciones, en varios miembros subalternos, encargados de hacer cumplir sus mandatos y voluntad: desde sembrar peces y mariscos, cuidar su desarrollo y multiplicación; hasta dirigir las mareas o controlar las calmas y tempestades.

claims.statement: Quintana Mansilla equates the Millalobo with Neptune or Poseidon of Greco-Roman mythology.
claims.statement_id: Quintana Mansilla menyamakan Millalobo dengan Neptunus atau Poseidon dari mitologi Yunani-Romawi.
claims.quote: El Millalobo, equivale a Neptuno o Poseidón, de la mitología grecorromana.

claims.statement: On special occasions he goes out with his beloved Huenchula to lonely beaches to enjoy the sun's rays.
claims.statement_id: Pada kesempatan istimewa, ia keluar bersama kekasihnya, Huenchula, ke pantai-pantai sepi untuk menikmati sinar matahari.
claims.quote: En ocasiones especiales, sale con su amada, la Huenchula, a las playas solitarias a disfrutar de los rayos del sol.

claims.statement: Memoria Chilena lists the Millalobo, along with the Pincoya, among the divinities of the ever-present sea in Chilote mythology.
claims.statement_id: Memoria Chilena menyebut Millalobo, bersama La Pincoya, sebagai salah satu dewa laut dalam mitologi Chiloé.
claims.quote: por la otra, las divinidades del mar omnipresente, como el Millalobo o la Pincoya.

claims.statement: In Kentucky folklore, the Milton Lizard is a creature described as resembling a 15-foot monitor lizard that was purportedly sighted in Cable Creek near the town of Milton.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kentucky, Kadal Milton adalah makhluk yang digambarkan menyerupai biawak sepanjang 15 kaki yang konon terlihat di Cable Creek, dekat kota Milton.
claims.quote: In Kentucky folklore, the Milton Lizard is a creature described as resembling a 15-foot monitor lizard that purportedly sighted in Cable Creek, near the town of Milton

claims.statement: The creature was first seen in July by Clarence "Tuffy" Cable, co-manager of the Blue Grass Body Shop, a junk and wrecking yard north of Milton.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk itu pertama kali terlihat pada Juli oleh Clarence "Tuffy" Cable, salah satu pengelola Blue Grass Body Shop, tempat rongsokan dan pembongkaran mobil di utara Milton.
claims.quote: The creature was first seen in July by Clarence "Tuffy" Cable, co-manager of the Blue Grass Body Shop, a junk and wrecking yard located north of Milton.

claims.statement: He saw the lizard emerge from behind the wrecked vehicles and it hissed at him several times.
claims.statement_id: Ia melihat kadal itu keluar dari balik bangkai kendaraan dan mendesis kepadanya beberapa kali.
claims.quote: he saw the lizard emerge from behind the wrecked vehicles and it hissed at him several times.

claims.statement: The creature was reported near the town of Milton, in Trimble County, Kentucky, in the summer of 1975.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk itu dilaporkan terlihat dekat kota Milton, di Trimble County, Kentucky, pada musim panas 1975.
claims.quote: near the town of Milton, in Trimble County, Kentucky, in the summer of 1975.

claims.statement: The catalog records the entity as having a lizard body with black and white stripes and speckles, white beneath the mouth, and large eyes similar to a frog's.
claims.statement_id: Katalog itu mencatat makhluk tersebut berbadan kadal dengan garis dan bintik hitam putih, bagian bawah mulut berwarna putih, dan mata besar mirip mata katak.
claims.quote: Entities skin color: Black and white stripes and speckles. Entities body: Lizard body. Entities head: White beneath the mouth. Entities eyes: Large, similar to a frog's eyes.

claims.statement: Cable's brother Garrett was the next to see it, on July 27: he saw a pile of old car hoods begin to vibrate and move as the lizard's head and shoulders emerged from beneath the debris.
claims.statement_id: Garrett, saudara Cable, orang berikutnya yang melihatnya pada 27 Juli: ia melihat tumpukan kap mobil tua bergetar dan bergerak ketika kepala dan bahu kadal itu muncul dari bawah puing.
claims.quote: Cable's brother Garrett was the next to see the creature on July 27. While working in the junkyard, he saw a pile of old car hoods begin to vibrate and move as the lizard's head and shoulders emerged from underneath the debris.

claims.statement: The next day Cable saw the lizard (or one like it) again, this time apparently larger, nearly 15 feet long; after he threw a rock at it, it hissed and fled into some brush.
claims.statement_id: Keesokan harinya Cable melihat kadal itu lagi (atau yang mirip), kali ini tampak lebih besar, hampir 15 kaki; setelah ia melempar batu, makhluk itu mendesis dan lari ke semak-semak.
claims.quote: The next day, Cable saw the lizard (or one similar to it) again, except this time it appeared to be larger—nearly 15 feet in length. After throwing a rock at it, the diminishing beast hissed at him and fled into some brush.

claims.statement: In early August a search party combed the area around the Blue Grass Body Shop for any sign of the lizard, but no evidence was found.
claims.statement_id: Pada awal Agustus, regu pencari menyisir sekitar Blue Grass Body Shop mencari tanda kadal itu, tetapi tidak ditemukan bukti.
claims.quote: In early August, a search party scoured the area surrounding the Blue Grass Body Shop for any sign of the lizard, but no evidence was found.

claims.statement: Cable theorized that one of the wrecked vehicles they had acquired from one of the western states contained eggs that hatched in the heat of the junkyard.
claims.statement_id: Cable berteori bahwa salah satu kendaraan rongsok yang mereka beli dari salah satu negara bagian barat mengandung telur yang menetas oleh panas tempat rongsokan itu.
claims.quote: He theorized that one of the wrecked vehicles they had acquired in the past from one of the western states contained eggs that hatched in the heat of the junkyard.

claims.statement: According to the compiler of this catalog, the story in the local newspaper took place in summer, not October, and involved two junkyard-worker brothers, Clarence and Garrett Cable, who several times glimpsed a big lizard; they tried to shoot it, but it was never found.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penyusun katalog ini, kisah yang dimuat koran lokal terjadi pada musim panas, bukan Oktober, dan melibatkan dua bersaudara pekerja tempat rongsokan, Clarence dan Garrett Cable, yang beberapa kali melihat kadal besar; mereka mencoba menembaknya tetapi makhluk itu tidak pernah ditemukan.
claims.quote: It took place in the summer, not October, and involved two brothers, Clarence and Garrett Cable, junkyard workers, who on several occasions glimpsed at a big lizard; they tried to shoot it, but the beast was never found.

claims.statement: The catalog notes that cryptozoologists, Fortean researchers and others report witnesses seeing a giant biped "lizard man" roaming the woods near an automobile junkyard.
claims.statement_id: Katalog itu mencatat bahwa kriptozoolog, peneliti Fortean, dan lainnya melaporkan saksi melihat "manusia kadal" raksasa berkaki dua yang berkeliaran di hutan dekat tempat rongsokan mobil.
claims.quote: Cryptozoologist, mystery mongers, Fortean researchers, and even ufologist, report that ... witnesses reported seeing a giant biped lizard man roaming the woods near an automobile junkyard

claims.statement: Cable fetched a rifle from his house and fired into the brush, but could not be certain he killed the creature.
claims.statement_id: Cable mengambil senapan dari rumahnya dan menembak ke semak-semak, tetapi tidak dapat memastikan apakah ia membunuh makhluk itu.
claims.quote: Cable retrieved a rifle from his house and fired into the brush, but couldn't be certain he killed the creature.

claims.statement: A 2025 radio station article names the place as Canip Creek.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah artikel stasiun radio (2025) menyebut tempat itu bernama Canip Creek.
claims.quote: It takes us back 50 years and to a place called Canip Creek.

claims.statement: The same article says other accounts put the cryptid at 12 feet.
claims.statement_id: Artikel yang sama menyebut bahwa penuturan lain menaksir panjang kriptid itu 12 kaki.
claims.quote: Other accounts put the cryptid (if that's what it was) at 12 feet.

claims.statement: Mary Jane "Minnie" Quay (1860-1876) is an apparition of keen interest to the paranormal circles of Michigan.
claims.statement_id: Mary Jane "Minnie" Quay (1860-1876) adalah sosok penampakan yang sangat menarik bagi kalangan paranormal Michigan.
claims.quote: Mary Jane "Minnie" Quay (1860 - 1876) is an apparition who has been of keen interest to the paranormal circles of Michigan.

claims.statement: Stories from old people in the area say one must leave something on her headstone or she will follow you home; most people leave coins.
claims.statement_id: Menurut cerita orang tua di daerah itu, orang harus meninggalkan sesuatu di batu nisannya atau ia akan mengikuti sampai ke rumah; kebanyakan orang meninggalkan koin.
claims.quote: The stories from old people in the area say you must leave something on her headstone or she will follow you home. Most people leave coins.

claims.statement: Her ghost is said to roam the beaches of Forester.
claims.statement_id: Hantunya konon berkeliaran di pantai-pantai Forester.
claims.quote: Her ghost has been said to roam the beaches of Forester.

claims.statement: The legend stems from a small lumbering town in the eastern part of Michigan known as The Thumb, called Forester, in present-day Forester Township.
claims.statement_id: Legenda ini berasal dari sebuah kota penebangan kecil di bagian timur Michigan, yang dikenal sebagai The Thumb, bernama Forester, di Forester Township sekarang.
claims.quote: The legend stems from a small foresting town in the eastern region of Michigan, known as The Thumb, called Forester, in present-day Forester Township.

claims.statement: In the legend she had given her heart to a young sailor whose ship often docked in Forester for shipping or trade.
claims.statement_id: Dalam legenda, ia jatuh hati pada seorang pelaut muda yang kapalnya sering bersandar di Forester untuk urusan pengiriman atau dagang.
claims.quote: She had given her heart to a young sailor whose ship would dock in Forester often for either shipping or merchant reasons.

claims.statement: In the early spring of 1876 word came back to Forester that his ship had gone down in the Great Lakes of Michigan.
claims.statement_id: Pada awal musim semi 1876, kabar sampai ke Forester bahwa kapal pelaut itu tenggelam di Danau-Danau Besar Michigan.
claims.quote: In the early spring of 1876, word came back to Forester that his ship had gone down in the Great Lakes of Michigan.

claims.statement: Some say she simply walks, waiting for her lover to dock, while others say she has tried to beckon young girls into the waters to their deaths.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang berkata ia hanya berjalan menunggu kekasihnya merapat, sedangkan yang lain menyatakan ia pernah mencoba memanggil gadis-gadis muda ke dalam air hingga tewas.
claims.quote: Some have said that she just walks, waiting for her lover to dock, while others have stated that she has tried to beckon young girls into the waters to their deaths.

claims.statement: Her ghost is said to have been seen walking the shoreline, and her mournful cries to be heard from the cemetery late at night as she still waits for her lover who will never come back.
claims.statement_id: Hantunya konon terlihat berjalan di pantai, dan tangisannya yang pilu terdengar dari pemakaman larut malam saat ia masih menunggu kekasih yang tak akan kembali.
claims.quote: Her ghost has been seen walking the shoreline ... her mournful cries of sorrow have been heard coming from the cemetery late at night as she still waits for her lover who will never come back

claims.statement: Some young women from Forester claim to have seen Minnie's apparition beckoning them to the waters as if inviting them to join her at the bottom.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa perempuan muda dari Forester mengaku melihat penampakan Minnie memanggil mereka ke air seakan mengajak bergabung di dasarnya.
claims.quote: young women from Forester claim that they've seen the apparition of Minnie beckoning them to the waters as if inviting them to join her at the bottom

claims.statement: The article quotes an 1876 newspaper report of the death of a girl named Minnie Quay, about fifteen, who threw herself into the lake from Smith's dock at Forester.
claims.statement_id: Artikel ini mengutip sebuah koran tahun 1876 yang melaporkan kematian seorang gadis bernama Minnie Quay, sekitar lima belas tahun, yang menceburkan diri ke danau dari dermaga Smith di Forester.
claims.quote: A young girl named Minnie Quay, about fifteen years of age, committed suicide by throwing herself into the lake from Smith's dock, at Forester

claims.statement: The hauntings of Minnie Quay are famous throughout Michigan's Thumb area and are among the favorite sites of paranormal investigators.
claims.statement_id: Penghantuan Minnie Quay terkenal di seluruh kawasan Thumb Michigan dan menjadi salah satu tempat favorit para penyelidik paranormal.
claims.quote: The Hauntings of Minnie Quay are famous throughout Michigan's thumb area and is one of the more well-known & favorite spots of paranormal investigators.

claims.statement: The radio station article says Minnie was born in May 1861.
claims.statement_id: Artikel stasiun radio ini menyebut Minnie lahir pada Mei 1861.
claims.quote: Minnie was born in May 1861. The Quays lived in Forester, a Michigan port town that hosted many sailors who put ashore.

claims.statement: The Mohan or Poira is a name applied to several supernatural creatures in South and Central American folklore.

claims.statement: Tahoe Tessie is a cryptid said to inhabit the depths of Lake Tahoe, on the border of California and Nevada.

claims.quote: Tahoe Tessie is a cryptid said to inhabit the depths of Lake Tahoe, a lake that straddles the border between California and Nevada.

claims.statement: Reports of Tessie date back to the mid-19th century, and it has become a well-known part of local folklore.
claims.statement_id: Laporan tentang Tessie sudah ada sejak pertengahan abad ke-19, dan makhluk ini menjadi bagian terkenal cerita rakyat setempat.
claims.quote: Reports of Tessie date back to the mid-19th century, and over time, the creature has become a well-known part of local folklore.

claims.statement: One of the earliest accounts dates from 1865, when I.C. Coggin of San Francisco reported a massive serpent-like creature.

claims.quote: One of the earliest accounts of a large creature in Lake Tahoe comes from 1865, when I.C. Coggin, a socialite from San Francisco, reported seeing a massive serpent-like creature.

claims.statement: The legend is often connected to Washoe beliefs in Water Babies, powerful spirits inhabiting the lake, especially around Cave Rock.

claims.quote: The legend of Tahoe Tessie is often connected to the beliefs of the Washoe people, who spoke of Water Babies, powerful spirits said to inhabit the lake, particularly around Cave Rock.

claims.statement: Though some claim Washoe roots, the current form of the legend dates mainly to the 20th century.
claims.statement_id: Meski ada yang menyebut akarnya dari budaya Washoe, bentuk legenda saat ini terutama berasal dari abad ke-20.
claims.quote: Although some claim that Tessie has roots in Washoe culture, the current form of the legend dates primarily to the 20th century.

claims.quote: One prominent theory suggests that the creature could be a giant sturgeon, a prehistoric-looking fish known to grow to large sizes.
